verdict.rationale: The cubic CLI docs say you can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to power local reviews, which avoids managing raw API keys. However, that relies on a paid third-party subscription, and nothing in the evidence describes a cubic free tier tied to personal sign-in; the only plan detail is workspace-level included reviewed-line capacity with paid flex overage. Missing for 10: documented free-tier access, personal-account sign-in flow, explicit statement that no API keys are needed, independent corroboration.
